problem_title: Recurring Fixing/Reparing Potholes — C V Raman Nagar (2019–2020)
problem_summary: 4 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in C V Raman Nagar between May 2019 and August 2020, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 75% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened). 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after initially being resolved.

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 125 pothole complaints.
35 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹13.7 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): Road work contracts exist in this ward, yet 75% of complaints remain unresolved. This may indicate that repairs were incomplete, inadequate, or that the work was performed in different road segments. Independent verification required.
HYPOTHESIS (unverified): 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after being marked resolved. This may indicate short-term or superficial repairs that did not address the underlying problem.
agency_attribution_note: 4 of 4 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.44). Top scoring factors: unresolved_rate=0.75, recurrence_years=0.67, description_severity=0.56.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='C V Raman Nagar' matched to datameet243=117 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.834).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for C V Raman Nagar for the period 2019–2020.
Request inspection records for the 35 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Investigate the 1 re-opened complaint(s) to determine whether patchwork repairs were applied and failed.
